project_type: Astro static site (marketing + docs) for keyflip CLI tool
test_framework: Astro build check (no unit tests needed for static site)
verification_instructions: 1. cd website && npm install 2. npm run build (must produce dist/ with no errors) 3. Verify both EN and TR pages are generated in dist/
environment_constraints: Open internet - npm install available. Do NOT deploy. Just build the site locally. Site lives in /website inside the monorepo.
contribution_requirements: Bilingual EN+TR. Modern design with dark mode. Developer-focused. SEO-friendly. Ready for GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages deployment.
key_patterns: The main project is zero-dep Node.js CLI. The website is a separate sub-project in /website with its own package.json. Content sources: README.md, README.tr.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.tr.md, docs/USE-CASES.md, docs/USE-CASES.tr.md, docs/PRODUCTIZATION.md. 130+ CLI commands organized by category. GitHub repo: hakkisagdic/keyflip.
directory_structure: keyflip/ is a Node.js CLI tool. /website will be a new Astro project with i18n support. Key docs in /docs/. Source in /src/ (100+ modules). Tests in /test/. The website pulls content from README and docs to generate static pages.
